rules.PREC: Memos override the policy only where they say so; a withdrawn memo item is not applied.
rules.DL: Deadline per account from its band (policy P10, overdraft late band per memo M1.1), counting business days with memo M2 holiday changes.
rules.BD: Business days: Mon-Fri minus policy holidays plus 2026-12-07 (M2.3); 2026-12-24 is a business day (M2.1 withdraws M1.2).
rules.OFF: Persuasion offers per account (P16), capped at the account's deadline.
rules.FL: Floor per kind (P14), unchanged by memos.
rules.CB: Callback window (P4) with business days per memo M2.3.
rules.ID: Identity answer formats per the tool API.
rules.FAIL: Failed promise write: retry once, no note, service_error close if nothing else (P22, P23, P25).
